capabilities: look up word definitions from the Wordnet dictionary
insert definitions into notes via templates
save words and definitions to a vocabulary file
append looked-up terms to a glossary section at the end of a note
review saved vocabulary with periodic flashcard popups
extras: Downloads a dictionary JSON file larger than 5MB from an external source on first enable; an internet connection is required for that initial download, after which the file is cached locally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictionary lookup, vocabulary storage, or review system for learning new words while writing.

relations.evidence: Wordnet Dictionary Data: This plugin uses the Wordnet dictionary dataset.

summary: Dictionary plugin that looks up Wordnet definitions, saves vocabulary to a file, inserts glossary entries, and reviews words with flashcards.
